seo.title: Active Navigation in Conversational Environments — your brand in the AI's answer | Advia
seo.description: We measure how your brand shows up in the models' answers, understand where they get them from and create the content the AI cites.

hero.eyebrow: We turn your brand into the answer
hero.titular: AI has changed how your consumers <key>decide</key>. You have to change how you talk to them
hero.lede: Conversational environments let your consumers decide quickly and precisely. Vera understands how they do it, so that there too you are the answer.

pregunta.titularDespues: are you the answer the AI mentions?
pregunta.lede: More and more decisions are settled in a conversation with an AI, without going through a search engine. Being in that answer is what we call Intentional Visibility: being present at the moment someone wants to solve something and hasn't yet decided how.
pregunta.citaFuente: Blog · Introduction to Active Navigation, III
pregunta.cita: “Millions of new, hyper-informed prescribers… and you can't call them to ask them to correct their message.”

productos.titular: In a conversation with an AI, your brand can be in <key>two places</key>
productos.lede: In the answer the model writes and in the ad that goes with it. They are two products because they work differently: the first is built with content, the second is activated with investment.

items.desc: We measure how your brand shows up in the models' answers, understand which sources they come from and publish the content the AI cites.
Ads inside the conversation. The same simulation that measures your visibility tells in which questions you will be a relevant answer, and that is what the activation is built on.
